bagPolicy.summary: Small purses and bags are allowed after search, without a clear-bag requirement. Large bags and backpacks, including laptop bags, are prohibited; no maximum dimensions are published.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is available in the RT Dairies deck and a second deck on Old Flat Shoals Road. The deck gives the first 30 minutes free; rates are posted by the parking operator.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Set your rideshare destination to 777 Memorial Drive SE, Atlanta, GA 30316. The designated drop-off point is outside the main lower-level doors and box office.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available on the rooftop during shows, opening at door time. Outside food and beverages and bottles are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Both the 777 Memorial Drive main entrance and the 800 Old Flat Shoals Road lower entrance are accessible. ADA viewing is on the floor and upper mezzanine; request an interpreter two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue’s published FAQ and prohibited-item rules do not state a general re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call opens at the venue box office two hours before doors on show night.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The main entrance is at 777 Memorial Drive, with another accessible entrance at 800 Old Flat Shoals Road. The interval from doors to showtime is typically an hour; check the event listing.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
